title: Alex and broken contest
statementMd:
One day Alex was creating a contest about his friends, but accidentally deleted it. Fortunately, all the problems were saved, but now he needs to find them among other problems.

But there are too many problems, to do it manually. Alex asks you to write a program, which will determine if a problem is from this contest by its name.

It is known, that problem is from this contest if and only if its name contains one of Alex's friends' name **exactly once**. His friends' names are "`Danil`", "`Olya`", "`Slava`", "`Ann`" and "`Nikita`".

**Names are case sensitive.**

## Input

The only line contains string from lowercase and uppercase letters and "`_`" symbols of length, not more than $100$ — the name of the problem.

## Output

Print "`YES`", if problem is from this contest, and "`NO`" otherwise.
statementZhMd:
一天，Alex 正在创建一个关于他的朋友们的比赛，但不小心把它删除了。幸运的是，所有题目都保存了下来，但现在他需要从其他题目中找出这些题目。

然而，题目太多了，无法手动完成。Alex 请你编写一个程序，根据题目名称判断某道题是否来自这场比赛。

已知，当且仅当题目名称中恰好包含 Alex 的某一位朋友的名字一次时，这道题才属于这场比赛。他的朋友名字是 `Danil`、`Olya`、`Slava`、`Ann` 和 `Nikita`。

**名字区分大小写。**

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含一个由小写字母、大写字母和 `_` 符号组成的字符串，长度不超过 $100$，表示题目名称。

## 输出格式

如果题目属于这场比赛，输出 `YES`，否则输出 `NO`。
